content: What do people think of the new file icons in the VSCode extension?

The first time I saw it it reminded me of Stephenson's Rocket in the Science Museum (very old steam train -- vertical bar of L was where the smoke came out, E was where the driver sat). But I didn't have my glasses on :-)
I'll replace them with forall icons soon - the icon from our website ended up being too visually noisy for use in VS Code.
I would love if the forall icons retained the pop of blue color! :) Imo it helps separate it visually from the gray text. (#386EE0 apparently, at least from the website)
